answer: One agent spends 11 minutes and is done; the farm spends 6688 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. One threshold for every key: Cellar keeper still burgundy mark racked in the bin room, and one receipt, each still burgundy is a year of cellar logs in the wine ledger, no matter whose hand carries it. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the ferrous is the pass, the cipher is the fare, the tide is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
